plan.title: Flywheel doctrine: require reading the review verdict for blocked issues — liveness metrics are not correctness
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: On 2026-07-26 the flywheel orchestrator reported PAN-3093 as "advancing healthily" for four consecutive ticks on rising cost and output alone, while the issue sat at CHANGES REQUESTED with five blocking findings — including a correctness bug letting a UAT generation promote obsolete feature code. The orchestrator's stall test answers "is the agent working?" but was used to answer "is the work good?"; the `rev=blocked` pointer was in its own status snapshots the whole time, and a cost drop (fresh session after a review block) was explained away as benign instead of triggering a review read.
narratives.Proposal: Insert one additive doctrine clause into the Observe step of roles/flywheel.md, immediately after the "verify agents are ACTUALLY progressing" paragraph and before `Run skill `pan-agent-activity``, requiring the orchestrator to read `<workspace>/.pan/review/<runId>/synthesis.md` (verdict + blocking findings) for any issue whose review_status is blocked or failed, and to report "blocked, N findings, converging/not" — never "healthy". Text applied verbatim from the issue body. Commit carries a Prompt-Change: trailer (scripts/check-prompt-change-trailer.sh gate). Edit is strictly additive so tests/unit/prompts/prompt-invariants.test.ts stays green.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No mechanical enforcement (hooks, linters, status-snapshot or read-model code changes) — doctrine-only issue.
- No changes to the review role, synthesis format, or the `.pan/review/<runId>/` layout.
- No fix for the PAN-3093 fetchFeatureBranch correctness bug itself (tracked separately).
- No rewording or removal of any existing line in roles/flywheel.md.

autoDecisions.summary: Single-item plan applying the issue body's clause verbatim.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue supplies the exact patch text, its location, and its acceptance criteria; decomposition heuristics say absorb trivia rather than inflate task count for a one-clause insert.

autoDecisions.summary: Docs requirement satisfied by the same edit (roles/flywheel.md is the doctrine surface).
autoDecisions.rationale: roles/flywheel.md is the documented flywheel prompt; no Mintlify or docs/ page documents per-tick reporting doctrine, and the finalize docs gate accepts a .md file in an item's files_scope.
The issue asks for a doctrine clause in the flywheel prompt and names acceptance only on the file's content; adding hooks or lint rules would be unrequested scope.

items.title: Insert the LIVENESS IS NOT CORRECTNESS doctrine clause into roles/flywheel.md

expected_outputs: grep returns a line inside the Observe step, positioned before the `Run skill `pan-agent-activity`` mention
prompt-invariants test suite passes with no failures

narrative.Action: In roles/flywheel.md, find the Observe step paragraph ending `same question, or churn). Run skill `pan-agent-activity`:` (currently around lines 284-287 — locate by anchor text, not line number). Split the paragraph after `churn).` and insert, between that sentence and `Run skill `pan-agent-activity``, the doctrine clause from the PRD (.pan/drafts/PAN-3147.md, Proposal section) VERBATIM: the paragraph beginning `**LIVENESS IS NOT CORRECTNESS — for every issue whose `review_status` is `blocked` or `failed`, READ THE REVIEW VERDICT before you describe it in any report.**` through `...in its own status snapshots the whole time.)`. Match the file's existing 3-space-indented, hard-wrapped paragraph style. Insert a blank line before and after the clause. Change nothing else — every existing line must be preserved (tests/unit/prompts/prompt-invariants.test.ts asserts load-bearing rails in this file). Commit with a commit body containing the trailer `Prompt-Change: require reading the review verdict for blocked/failed issues before reporting them healthy (PAN-3093 miss)` — scripts/check-prompt-change-trailer.sh rejects commits touching roles/*.md without it. Push the feature branch immediately after committing.

items.title: Given the Observe step of roles/flywheel.md, when the clause text is inspected, then it contains the verbatim LIVENESS IS NOT CORRECTNESS clause — including the PAN-3093 incident citation, the `<workspace>/.pan/review/<runId>/synthesis.md` verdict path, and the prescribed report form `blocked, N findings, converging/not` — positioned immediately after the ACTUALLY-progressing paragraph and before `Run skill `pan-agent-activity``
Given `git diff origin/main -- roles/flywheel.md`, when the diff is inspected, then it shows only added lines (the clause plus the paragraph split) and preserves every pre-existing line unmodified
Given the feature branch commit, when `bash scripts/check-prompt-change-trailer.sh` runs against origin/main, then it exits 0 because the commit body contains a `Prompt-Change:` trailer
Given the edited file, when `npx vitest run tests/unit/prompts/prompt-invariants.test.ts` runs, then it passes with zero failures, confirming the load-bearing prompt rails survive the edit
